units.raw: The Parties wish to explore and evaluate a prospective commercial transaction involving logistics automation software and enterprise platform integration (the "Permitted Purpose"). In the course of such exploration, each Party may disclose to the other Party certain proprietary and confidential information. The Parties agree to safeguard such information pursuant to the terms and conditions set forth below.
